See also: lesbe and lespe

German

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Clipping of Lesbierin.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈlɛspə/
  • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

Noun

[edit]

Lesbe f (genitive Lesbe, plural Lesben)

  1. (colloquial) lesbian
    Synonym: (more formal) Lesbierin

Declension

[edit]
Declension of Lesbe [feminine]
singular plural
indef. def. noun def. noun
nominative eine die Lesbe die Lesben
genitive einer der Lesbe der Lesben
dative einer der Lesbe den Lesben
accusative eine die Lesbe die Lesben
